title: KEEPFILTERS intersects the new filter with the existing filter on the same column
query: DEFINE MEASURE Sales[Only Red] = CALCULATE ( [Sales Amount], KEEPFILTERS ( 'Product'[Color] = "Red" ) )

source.quote: If Red is not included in the current filter context, the result is blank.
source.supports: the page's Only Red Sales measure is blank when Red is not in the current filter context

source.quote: the filter is added to the filter context without overwriting existing filters over the same column(s)
source.supports: with KEEPFILTERS the filter is added without overwriting the existing one

derivation: Red row: Color = Red and Color = Red: 460. Blue row: Color = Blue and Color = Red: no product, BLANK. Green row: the same, BLANK. ADDCOLUMNS keeps the BLANK rows.
notes: SUM of a fixed decimal (currency) column is taken to be a fixed decimal, as in the seed cases.
